guitar.evidence: Brian May's homemade "Red Special" guitar is one of the most iconic and well-documented instruments in rock history.

tone.target: bright Queen-style stadium rock crunch with sustaining lead and vocal sustain
tone.profile: bright Queen-style stadium rock crunch with sustaining lead and vocal sustain
tone.summary: A classic British crunch tone using the UK 50 or UK SLP model, paired with a bright 4x12 cabinet. The chain emphasizes compression for sustain, followed by moderate distortion and polished reverb to achieve an anthemic, sustained lead sound.
